scope: RPKI closure only; no Phase 18, DNS, new sources or volume deletion
authorization: Owner replied 'Cần thiết thì extend' to VM capacity gate; disk only enlarged 24 to 64 GiB, CPUs 2 and RAM 6 GiB unchanged
stages: A: owned offline regressions and three matched fresh-JVM pilot pairs, 8192 source rows in eight 1024-row callbacks
B: actual Kafka/MinIO owned-fixture smoke and eight checkpoint interruption points
C: one complete pinned real day, fresh isolated prefix/topic/checkpoint
D: two complete pinned real days, fresh isolated prefix/topic/checkpoint
E: fourteen complete pinned real days, only after C/D and resource gates pass
failure_policy: Stop affected stage on identity/oracle/resource failure; preserve failed evidence. No blind retries or timeout increases.
performance_claim: Within-domain matched callback experiment only. No streaming superiority or RIS velocity comparison.
independence: Existing source-based SQLite oracle unchanged; exact source-map/member-set barriers required, not count-only acceptance.
publication: Only aggregates, hashes, owned fixtures and code committed; external raw and normalized records remain private. Instructor approval and raw redistribution remain unverified.
